items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Erroll and I played in the Bebop places.

ctx.x: Okay. Well, after Kirby, which breaks up at the end of the War... What do you do now? You start working with your own trio?

We disbanded in Los Angeles. At that time Coleman Hawkins was playing at Billy Berg's. We played at the Plantation in Los Angeles. At that time...so Billy Berg... And I came back east with...who's the drummer...? He played with Erroll, too, on the Concert by the Sea. Denzil Best. Denzil and I came east together.
